objectives: To synthesize the latest findings on the neurobiology of body dysmorphic disorder (BDD), quantify brain activation patterns with activation likelihood estimation (ALE) meta-analysis, and propose an updated BDD neurocircuitry model.
inclusion_criteria: All studies regarding neuroimaging and functional neurochemistry research in BDD were considered. Studies were included if they met the following eligibility criteria: full-text availability in English, publication in a peer-reviewed journal, BDD diagnosed per DSM criteria, and demographically matched healthy control participants.
